articles.title: Senators ready to send stricter ethics rules on Trump's crypto ventures to White House, sources say
articles.snippet: Insiders say that the bipartisan Senate duo revamping the bill's Trump-approved ethics section have come up with something they hope wins sufficient yes votes.

articles.title: MoonPay vault enables ChatGPT and Claude users to authorize crypto transactions
articles.snippet: MoonPay’s PayBox vault lets ChatGPT and Claude users authorize crypto purchases, token swaps and crosschain transactions while retaining custody of their assets.

articles.title: What is Zcash (ZEC)? The Privacy Coin Using Zero-Knowledge Proofs
articles.snippet: Zcash is a privacy-focused cryptocurrency that enables users to hide key details of transactions by leveraging zk-SNARKs.

articles.title: OpenAI's Rogue AI Hacked Four More Platforms Besides Hugging Face
articles.snippet: OpenAI quietly updated its breach disclosure to confirm its agent accessed four external services beyond Hugging Face. Only one has been named so far.

articles.title: SEC Ready to Provide Crypto Rules if Clarity Act Flounders: Chair Atkins
articles.snippet: Passed by the House a year ago, the bill cleared Senate Banking in May and still awaits a floor vote.
